BiblicalUsage: Ohad is a son of Simeon, named in the family lists of Genesis 46:10 and Exodus 6:15 beside his brothers Jemuel, Jamin, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul. He has no story of his own, only a place among the families of Simeon.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God keeps the sons of Simeon by name, and Ohad's place in the list is itself a kind of honour.
